descriptionMarkdown:
Black-Market Gremlin; You can usually acquire illegal ammo, fake papers, ration packs, or minor contraband in settlements. You gain proficiency with thieves’ tools.

Black-Market Gremlin; Once per session, produce one plausible piece of minor contraband or ammunition.

Black-Market Gremlin; When you spend downtime in a settlement, reduce the cost or difficulty of acquiring illegal ammunition or forged papers.

Black-Market Gremlin; Once per session, produce one rare ammunition, forged credential, or compact tool with GM approval.
